query:
Who was it that mentioned sending a prepared note to Tanya so she could relay a specific medical question to the doctor before Loretta's appointment?

Options:
A. Loretta
B. Tanya
C. Diane
D. Kevin
context:
[1] (about=Tanya, episodic, t6 @2026-02-01T17:35:00) Mom sent me the note, I forwarded it to the office Monday. Proactive is always better with cardiology, it lets them prepare rather than react in-room.
[2] (about=Diane, episodic, t6 @2026-02-01T17:28:00) That's good news, Mama. Did he address the fluid retention question? And did Tanya's note reach his office in time?
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Diane, group-interaction, t0 @2026-01-11T16:02:00) Diane will send fluid retention question to Tanya, who will flag with Dr. Mensah's office.
[4] (about=Loretta, episodic, t12 @2026-02-22T15:42:00) Tanya, that is exactly right. This chat is Sunday dinner. It is not the doctor's office.
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-02-15T17:07:00) she was fine. scared more than anything. meds had gotten mixed in with some other stuff in a cabinet. I went up, found them, reorganized the kitchen while I was there. she didn't want me to make a thing of it.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tanya, group-insight, t14 @2026-03-01T16:13:00) Tanya says things are ok: Kevin confirmed, Marcus asking about medications, Grandma has forsythia and a full freezer.
agent_answer:
C. Diane.  

Diane is the one who arranged to send the prepared fluid-retention question to Tanya, who then flagged it with the doctor’s office (per the memory slice: “Diane will send fluid retention question to Tanya, who will flag with Dr. Mensah’s office”). Tanya received/forwarded it, but the note originated with Diane.
